trello.name: Fix Android 14 photo upload crash
trello.desc: Marcus to fix the NullPointerException in the media picker callback on Android 14 that occurs when backgrounding the app mid-upload. Deadline is Wednesday.

trello.name: Verify Android 14 crash fix
trello.desc: Sam to confirm the Android 14 photo upload crash fix on test devices and add it to the regression run.

trello.name: Build backend sync API for offline notes
trello.desc: Elena to build the sync API for offline mode where the client sends its last-synced timestamp and receives a delta of created, updated, and deleted notes. Conflict resolution is last-write-wins. Have the API in review before being out on the 17th and 18th.

trello.name: Implement client-side offline mode for notes list
trello.desc: Marcus to implement the client side for offline mode, including a local cache in Room, queuing writes while offline, and replaying them upon reconnection. Acceptance criteria: app can be opened in airplane mode, notes can be viewed and edited, and everything reconciles with no data loss when back online. Write acceptance criteria into the ticket.

trello.name: Migrate CI pipelines to GitHub Actions
trello.desc: Sam to migrate pipelines to GitHub Actions, finishing test and release pipelines and keeping the nightly build schedule. Run both GitHub Actions and Jenkins in parallel for a week before turning Jenkins off. Keep Jenkins alive until the parallel week is clean.

trello.name: Add per-user rate limiting to search endpoint
trello.desc: Elena to add per-user rate limiting to the search endpoint: 100 requests per minute per user, return HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header beyond that, and include a metrics counter to see who is hitting the limit.

trello.name: Update privacy policy screen for GDPR compliance
trello.desc: Marcus to update the privacy policy screen so consent is opt-in with separate toggles for analytics and marketing, with nothing pre-checked. Get the new copy from legal. This is a launch blocker for the August 20 release.

trello.name: Write regression tests for payments flow
trello.desc: Sam to write regression tests for the payments flow, covering purchase, restore, cancellation, and the receipt validation path. Goal is to have them running in CI as part of the new GitHub Actions pipeline.
